Dear Mayor Quimby and Mr. Skinner,

We, the undersigned, hereby submit a petition for the protection of our environment. We are deeply concerned about the increasing pollution in our city and the negative impact it has on our health and well-being. We urge you to take immediate action to address this issue by implementing stricter regulations on industrial emissions and waste disposal. Additionally, we request that you allocate more resources to the maintenance and improvement of our public parks and green spaces. These areas provide essential recreational and leisure opportunities for our community and contribute to the overall quality of life in our city. We hope that you will give this matter your utmost attention and take the necessary steps to ensure a cleaner, healthier environment for all residents. Thank you for your time and consideration. Sincerely, Lisa Simpson
